title: Codex Reflection
desc: Codex CLI (wkcodex.sh) reflection skill: recurring false-success and identity-resolution lessons for Codex delegations.
steps: 2026-07-14: wkcodex.sh dispatched in background for an errors.jsonl triage task returned rc=0 but the output file contained ONLY harness/pace/stall-reset log lines -- zero actual triage content. This is the documented false-success pattern (orchestrate-sectors-parallel-while-knowledgeifying step 5): background codex can report success with empty output and zero real work done. Fix: always read the full output content after a codex background dispatch completes, never trust rc=0 alone; if output is harness-noise-only, treat as a failed dispatch and redo the investigation via a direct tool call or a properly-briefed native Agent instead of retrying wkcodex.sh a third time blindly.

IDENTITY-RESOLUTION GAP: this session's agent-failure-reflection-gate resolved the failing background codex dispatch to a BLANK model identity (no gpt/codex/gpt-mini match), forcing creation of this skill from scratch rather than routing to an existing gpt-reflection/gpt-mini-reflection entry. Fix candidate for the harness: the model-to-reflection-skill resolver should recognize a wkcodex.sh Bash dispatch (no native Agent tool_use, no CODEX_THREAD_ID) as codex family and route to gpt-reflection/gpt-mini-reflection by default instead of leaving model blank.
